flights = get_results_from_cache(key="flights")

# Filter flights by first class
filtered_flights = filter_flights(prior_results=flights, flight_class=["first"])

# Save filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_flights", value=filtered_flights)

# Retrieve cached hotel results
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Filter hotels by gym and wifi amenities
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(prior_results=hotels, gym_present=True, free_wifi_included=True)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Retrieve cached restaurant results
restaurants = get_results_from_cache(key="restaurants")

# Filter restaurants by Japanese and Thai cuisine
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(prior_results=restaurants, cuisine=["Japanese", "Thai"])

# Save filtered restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Find nearest restaurants to the hotel
nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(hotels=filtered_hotels, restaurants=filtered_restaurants, groupBy="restaurant")

# Save nearest restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_restaurants", value=nearest_restaurants)

print("No planning needed")
